BlueprintCallable
Call this function to load a set of levels and signal when all levels in the set have finished loading. This function should only be used for dedicated loading KGameStates when loading from a save file. Use GetSaveData() on the SaveManagerSubsystem to retrieve what levels were loaded when the save file was written.

NOTE: Make sure to subscribe to the LevelManagerSubsystem's OnLoadComplete event to wait for and resume once loading is complete.
Unloads all levels in the game (not including persistent level).
